note: What each taxonomy-v2 issue code means. Given to the group model so it names the category the code actually holds, not the most extreme quote. '.other' codes are catch-alls for complaints in that topic that matched no specific rule.

descriptions.access.login_failure: cannot log in or sign in
descriptions.access.logged_out: the app logs the user out unexpectedly
descriptions.access.phone_email_verification: phone-number, OTP or email verification problems when signing in
descriptions.access.account_hacked_or_lost: account hacked, taken over, deleted, suspended or lost
descriptions.access.signup: cannot create an account or sign up
descriptions.access.connection_offline: account access blocked by connection or offline errors
descriptions.usability.ads: too many, too long or too loud ads interrupting listening (free tier)
descriptions.usability.removed_features_update: features removed or restricted by a recent update
descriptions.usability.shuffle_order: forced shuffle or random order; cannot choose or play a specific song
descriptions.usability.queue_playlist: queue, playlist, library or liked-songs management problems
descriptions.usability.ui_change: disliked redesign, layout, home screen, font or visual changes
descriptions.usability.autoplay_cant_stop: app starts playing by itself or cannot be stopped or turned off
descriptions.usability.controls_widget: player controls, buttons, widget, lock screen, repeat or seek problems
descriptions.usability.podcast_ui: podcast, audiobook or video experience problems
descriptions.playback.crash_or_wont_open: app crashes, freezes or will not open
descriptions.playback.plays_wrong_song: plays a different or random song instead of the one chosen
descriptions.playback.stops_or_pauses: music stops, pauses or cuts out during playback
descriptions.playback.not_playing: songs or the app will not play at all
descriptions.playback.bugs_glitches: general bugs, glitches and unstable behaviour
descriptions.playback.lag_or_skips: lag, buffering, slowness or songs skipping by themselves
descriptions.playback.connection_error: connection, network or server errors during playback
descriptions.playback.device_bluetooth_car: problems on Bluetooth, car, speakers, TV, watch or casting
descriptions.playback.battery_data_storage: battery drain, data use or storage use
descriptions.downloads.downloads_disappear: downloaded music disappears or must be re-downloaded
descriptions.catalog.missing_content: songs, artists or content missing, unavailable or removed
descriptions.catalog.search: search does not find what the user wants
descriptions.catalog.recommendations: poor or repetitive recommendations, radio, DJ or smart shuffle
descriptions.catalog.liked_library: liked songs or saved playlists lost or empty
descriptions.catalog.content_controversy: content or artist controversies (royalties, AI music, specific hosts)
descriptions.billing.premium_only_feature: basic features (choosing songs, skipping, lyrics, shuffle control) now require Premium
descriptions.billing.ads_for_paying_users: Premium or paying users still get ads
descriptions.billing.charges_refunds: unexpected charges, payment failures or refunds
descriptions.billing.subscription_activation: Premium not activating, not renewing or not reflected after payment
descriptions.billing.promotion_trial: trials, promotions, student, family or duo plan problems
descriptions.billing.monetization_greed: the company is seen as greedy or money-focused
descriptions.billing.price: Premium price too high or increased
descriptions.billing.other: other complaints about paying for Premium or the free tier
descriptions.support.unresponsive: customer support does not reply or cannot be reached
descriptions.support.unhelpful: customer support replies do not help
descriptions.other.boycott_political: boycott or political or religious protest against Spotify
descriptions.other.premium_paywall: general complaints about the Premium paywall
descriptions.other.bugs_not_working: the app simply does not work, without a specific defect
descriptions.other.update_made_worse: a recent update made the app worse, without a specific defect
descriptions.other.uninstalling_switching: uninstalling or switching to another music app
descriptions.other.general_negative: general dislike with no specific problem (e.g. 'worst app', 'hate this app')
